description: Implementation of a Windows-specific video decoder using Media Foundation and DirectX, supporting hardware-accelerated VP9, H264, and AV1 decoding, with management of decode targets and threading.

classes.name: VideoFrameImpl
classes.description: Implementation of VideoFrame that manages release callback.

methods.name: CreateVideoTransform
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaTransform for video decoding with specified GUIDs and device manager.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the media transform decoder based on the specified video codec.

methods.name: ShutdownCodec
methods.description: Releases decoder resources and resets the decoder thread.

methods.name: EnsureDecoderThreadRunning
methods.description: Starts the decoder thread if not already running.

methods.name: StopDecoderThread
methods.description: Stops the decoder thread and clears event queue.

methods.name: UpdateVideoArea
methods.description: Updates the video output area based on media type attributes.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame from an IMFSample, managing output samples.

methods.name: DeleteVideoFrame
methods.description: Removes a VideoFrame from internal tracking.

methods.name: DecoderThreadRun
methods.description: Main loop for decoding, processing input/output events, and managing priming.

methods.name: ReleaseDecodeTargets
methods.description: Releases cached decode targets during shutdown.
